title: The Fall of Constantinople
description: April-May 1453. The player commands the last defenders of Byzantium under Constantine XI. Hold the Theodosian Walls against Mehmed II's siege: repair breaches from bombard fire, guard the sea walls along the Golden Horn, and survive repeated assaults. Defeat comes if the Hagia Sophia district falls; victory means holding until the final assault is broken.

anachronisms_found: SALADIN hero used as Sultan Mehmed II: Saladin died in 1193, was a Kurdish Ayyubid, not an Ottoman, and is 260 years out of period. The engine offers other options (a generic Champion/Cavalier renamed, or the Turkish Janissary line) so this named-hero mismatch was avoidable.
TREE_PALM_FOREST x6 as the vegetation around Constantinople: Thrace and the Bosphorus are oak/pine country, not palm; the engine has abundant temperate forest tiles.

CAMEL_RIDER x4 in the Ottoman siege line: the 1453 besieging army was built around janissary infantry, azaps, sipahi horse and the great bombard; camels were baggage animals, not a shock arm. HAND_CANNONEER/JANISSARY was available in the engine and unused.

No Wonder placed for Hagia Sophia — the Byzantine Wonder in the engine literally IS Hagia Sophia, yet the church is apparently represented by a plain MONASTERY, undercutting the scenario's own central objective.
